# MerchFrom

> MerchFrom helps artists, brands and creators design, source and sell premium merchandise.

Membership is by application. MerchFrom is based in Barcelona, Spain.

## Pages on merchfrom.com

- /: the door, with sign-in for members and the application.
- /faq/: short answers about MerchFrom.
- /watch/: a short film about one run, from brief to doorstep.
- /agents/: connecting your own AI agent over MCP. Opening to members soon.
